limitations: Selected local writes only; no census of all MMIO writers or preservation after initialization.
The three getter calls read the same u32 storage at different times; producer, live value and stability remain open.
The alternate address/mask can be cross-checked against a pinned kernel reference; primary address meaning is not established by that match.
Nominal OR stores are not readback, IOCC activation, cache snooping, SMMU bypass or proof of coherent DMA.
Pinned custom-kernel source declaration/driver intent, not the stock HZC2 DTB or device register state.
DTS parser supports flattened nodes and literal u32 cells only; opaque unrelated property values are not interpreted.
Source witnesses do not build or execute kernel code; regmap/exynos_pmu_update implementations and error effects are outside this cross-check.
Only the alternate address with query=1 is matched; unknown producer/stability can yield other table/mask combinations.
No proof of CPU/device ownership, snooping, cache freshness, SMMU/bus translation, preserved configuration or successful storage I/O.
QEMU RAM cells and modified data-table pointer fields replace Samsung MMIO; no cache/device/coherence model.
Selector, pointer pair load and RMW are executed as separate original fragments; intervening padding-control instructions and full initializer are omitted.
Debugger supplies cd31c8 storage immediately before each original getter read; mixed sequences are controls, not observed device behavior.
Null IOCC pointer is a synthetic skip control; both pinned data tables have nonzero pointers.
Guarded u32 RAM writes do not establish IOCC delivery/readback, SMMU/bus identity, ownership or successful UFS transfer.
